limits: The denominator contains only caller-declared promises; completeness over the document or project is not established.
A unique exact quote and a resolved document field pin declared locations; their semantic correspondence is not inferred or verified.
Coverage requires exact declared requirement metadata and references; coverage and comparison satisfaction are separate observations.
Several promises may share an obligation or repeat a requirement; they are not independent checks or independent evidence.
Only the embedded obligations-1 report and its captured candidate are examined; no live state or cross-database transaction is checked.
A matched configuration declaration does not establish program behavior, prose truth, authorship, or permission to accept or publish.
Coverage does not remove upstream blockers or record human review; content hashes establish internal consistency only.
Only descriptors in the previous caller-declared inventory are considered; preservation of that denominator does not establish completeness over either document.
A reusable descriptor preserves an exact unique quote, selected typed values, declared requirement and rendering dependencies; their semantic correspondence is not inferred.
Artifact and obligation renames require an explicit injective mapping; symbols, JSON paths, scope, relation and quotes are never guessed or rewritten.
Every old promise remains in the draft; obligation references are cleared for descriptors that require review, so omission cannot silently improve coverage.
File, fragment and position changes are reported separately; unchanged selected values do not establish program behavior or truth of prose.
Rendering dependencies cover all bindings of each selected artifact; an unrelated binding change can conservatively require new consideration.
Source blockers are historical observations; target blockers remain effective. No editorial decisions or formal approvals are transferred to the target.
Only captured reports are examined, with no live-state observation or atomic transaction between databases; hashes establish internal consistency only.
A new draft always requires human review and never authorizes acceptance or publication.

limitations: The manually authored inventory lists two promises and does not establish completeness of a page.
Descriptor reuse compares captured declared locations, values and dependencies; it is not semantic certification or approval transfer.
The path mapping targets separately seeded artifacts; no runtime rename or deletion of original files occurs.
Fresh self-declared programmed decisions are recorded for each exact packet; identical content can share a content-addressed packet.
Fictional semantic metadata concerns retry methods only and does not independently validate whole prose or attempt limits.
Proposed Python code is not executed, no external LLM or human review is simulated, and no release is created.
Saved reports capture observations; there is no live-state check or shared transaction of the two databases.
Worker pool size is not a measured capacity, a quality benchmark or a number of independent models.
